title: Avoid pending-preparation guidance for --rebaseline when no preparation is pending
outcome: Avoid pending-preparation guidance for --rebaseline when no preparation is pending
acceptance: When --rebaseline is refused without an admitted pending preparation, the message gives the applicable enable-task-sync remedy and does not direct the operator to resume a nonexistent destination; regression tests cover disabled/no-pending and completed-only cases.

completion.summary: Delivered the corrected --rebaseline refusal guidance and regressions. Full gate test-489d5569-02f7-4df3-b7d5-3d9321d8d9a2 passed 12/12 on the frozen carried input; independent evaluation ae6f66c113d549e6bf2d752fa21be13a passed 1/1. Landed and installed the gated release.
